patch_description:
This program is a crossover between two previous ANSATZ designs. It keeps the strong symmetry-based parametrization from the higher-performing candidate (shared RY across corners/edges/center, CRZ ring + center couplings, ZZZ motifs aligned with winning lines, CCRZ high-order correlations, and compact final rotations) and adds a lightweight, symmetry-grouped pre-RZ layer (corners/edges/center). The pre-RZ layer increases single-qubit expressivity while remaining parameter-efficient by sharing across symmetry zones. All other parts of the original training and evaluation scaffolding are preserved (feature map, re-uploading, training loop, measurements, early stopping, etc.), and connectivity/parameter-sharing constraints are respected. The EVOLVE-BLOCK markers are preserved and only ANSATZ_SPEC is modified.

Rationale:
- Keep the proven motif-aligned triples (ZZZ and CCRZ) which likely capture game-winning correlations.
- Preserve CRZ shared entanglers for strong, parameter-efficient two-qubit coupling around the ring and to center.
- Add three shared pre-RZ parameters (corners, edges, center) to give richer local rotations before entangling, improving optimization without a large parameter cost.
- Maintain compact final rotations shared by symmetry for readout tuning.

This balances expressivity and parameter efficiency to aim for improved validation/test performance and reduced generalization gap.
